# apple_profile (Resource)

Creates a provisioning profile. Profiles cannot be changed, so changing any argument creates a new one.

A profile becomes `INVALID` when one of its certificates is revoked or expires, one of its devices is disabled, or its bundle ID's capabilities change. The next plan after that, or after the profile expires, replaces it. Import it by its App Store Connect ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_profile" "app_store" {
  name            = "Example App Store"
  profile_type    = "IOS_APP_STORE"
  bundle_id       = apple_bundle_id.app.id
  certificate_ids = [apple_certificate.distribution.id]
}

resource "apple_profile" "development" {
  name            = "Example Development"
  profile_type    = "IOS_APP_DEVELOPMENT"
  bundle_id       = apple_bundle_id.app.id
  certificate_ids = [apple_certificate.development.id]
  device_ids      = [apple_device.test_phone.id]
}

# Write the profile for Xcode or a CI system.
resource "local_sensitive_file" "app_store" {
  content_base64 = apple_profile.app_store.profile_content
  filename       = "${path.module}/Example_App_Store.mobileprovision"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID, e.g. `apple_bundle_id.app.id`.
- `certificate_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the certificates the profile allows to sign the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the profile.
- `profile_type` (String) Profile type: `IOS_APP_ADHOC`, `IOS_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `IOS_APP_INHOUSE`, `IOS_APP_STORE`, `MAC_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `MAC_APP_DIRECT`, `MAC_APP_STORE`, `MAC_CATALYST_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `MAC_CATALYST_APP_DIRECT`, `MAC_CATALYST_APP_STORE`, `TVOS_APP_ADHOC`, `TVOS_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `TVOS_APP_INHOUSE`, `TVOS_APP_STORE`.

### Optional

- `device_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the devices, for development and ad hoc profiles.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) Creation date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the profile.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the profile.
- `profile_content` (String, Sensitive) The profile, base64-encoded. Write it to a `.mobileprovision` or `.provisionprofile` file with the `content_base64` argument of `local_sensitive_file`.
- `profile_state` (String) State of the profile: `ACTIVE` or `INVALID`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the profile.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_profile.app_store
  identity = {
    id = "9X7C5V3B1N"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the profile.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By App Store Connect ID or by name.
terraform import apple_profile.app_store 9X7C5V3B1N
terraform import apple_profile.app_store "Example App Store"
```
